what: Regression for the 2026-09-25 universe correction (docs/07 §3): 8 names removed from data/universe_screened.json by the instrument screen and the curated exclusions (BRKRP, SMCIP, MCHPP, STRF, STRC, STRK, SATA preferred/perpetual lines; SFD pork producer). 327 -> 319 names.
method: sim/run_sim.py with the frozen sim/strategies/trend.py alone; SIM_ENRICHED_SUBDIR=data/enriched_full; SIM_START=2023-01-03 (the OOS window of the election); commission and slippage at the election defaults (2 bps, 5 bps). 'original' uses data/raw_full/_manifest.json (327 names + IXIC); 'corrected' uses the same manifest filtered to the 319 corrected names + IXIC. The original run reproduces the election's trend OOS figures exactly.
reading: The agent never traded any removed name. The paths diverge from 2025-04-25 because the market-breadth input (share of the universe above its 50-day average) is computed over the whole universe. The corrected figures are within the path noise of a changed input; they are NOT evidence that the correction improves the agent. The election result (+207.6%, Sharpe 1.22) stays the official out-of-sample record; the corrected run is the reference for the deployed configuration.
